title: Comparison between Singapore and OECD's Electricity Tariffs
what_it_is: Comparison between Singapore and OECD's Electricity Tariffs

sections.label: Singapore electricity tariff comparison
sections.summary: Singapore's regulated electricity tariffs were about 1% higher than five countries from 2011 to 2015, but 13% lower than Ireland, Turkey and Japan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Based on the latest available data for these five countries, Singapore's regulated electricity tariffs were, on average, about 1% higher over the period from 2011 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: However, it is more meaningful to compare our regulated electricity tariffs with Ireland, Turkey and Japan, which rely mainly on imported natural gas, similar to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: When compared to these countries, Singapore's regulated electricity tariffs were, on average, 13% lower over the period from 2011 to 2015.
